notes: Two additions: the italic *only*, and the supplied indirect object *him* of *giveth him his sword*, for which the Hebrew writes no pronoun — rule 44 leaves such an object `added` rather than joining the verb.

The explicit `הוּא` takes only *He* while the copula joins the predicate noun (rule 20); the substantival article takes *He ... that* headed on the pronoun (rule 41), discontinuous around the italic *only*.
